headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 22, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins fell short in Cleveland, dropping a 2-5 decision to the Guardians. Ryan Jeffers led the Twins at the plate with a home run and an RBI. The Los Angeles Dodgers edged out the Philadelphia Phillies 2-1, with Max Muncy leading the offense and Justin Wrobleski earning the win. The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Toronto Blue Jays, securing a 12-2 victory. Nick Fortes led the offense with a 3-hit, 4-RBI performance, including a home run. The San Diego Padres secured an 8-3 victory over the Atlanta Braves, with Manny Machado leading the charge at the plate.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, impacting team availability. Drey Jameson, a right-hander for the Arizona Diamondbacks, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right hip inflammation. Jack Flaherty, a right-hander for the Detroit Tigers, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right flexor inflammation. Jose Corniell, a right-hander for the Texas Rangers, has been placed on the 15-day injured list. Will Smith, a catcher for the Los Angeles Dodgers, has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to neck inflammation.

The Colorado Rockies made a move on July 20, acquiring outfielder Landyn Vidourek from the Los Angeles Dodgers in exchange for right-handed pitcher Seth Halvorsen. The Athletics traded right-hander Aaron Civale to the Chicago Cubs for right-hander Aiden Moffett. The Kansas City Royals traded right fielder Rudy Martin Jr. to the Baltimore Orioles for cash. The Tampa Bay Rays traded right-hander Trey Pooser to the St. Louis Cardinals.
